{"oid": "17476", "proacl": null, "probin": null, "prosrc": "
        DECLARE
            sch text;
        BEGIN
            FOR sch IN
                SELECT n.nspname
                FROM pg_class c
                JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
                WHERE c.relname = 'memory_units' AND c.relkind = 'r'
            LOOP
                BEGIN
                    RETURN QUERY EXECUTE format($q$
                        SELECT %1$L::text, m.bank_id
                        FROM %1$I.memory_units m
                        JOIN %1$I.banks b ON b.bank_id = m.bank_id
                        WHERE m.consolidated_at IS NULL
                          AND m.consolidation_failed_at IS NULL
                          AND m.fact_type IN ('experience', 'world')
                          AND COALESCE(b.config -> 'enable_auto_consolidation', 'true'::jsonb) <> 'false'::jsonb
                          AND NOT EXISTS (
                              SELECT 1 FROM %1$I.async_operations o
                              WHERE o.bank_id = m.bank_id
                                AND o.operation_type = 'consolidation'
                                AND o.status IN ('pending', 'processing')
                          )
                        GROUP BY m.bank_id
                    $q$, sch);
                EXCEPTION
                    -- Schema or its tables vanished between the pg_class
                    -- snapshot and this query (tenant dropped or migrating).
                    WHEN undefined_table OR invalid_schema_name OR undefined_column THEN
                        CONTINUE;
                END;
            END LOOP;
        END;
        ", "procost": 100, "prokind": "f", "prolang": "15214", "proname": "banks_needing_consolidation", "prorows": 1000, "pronargs": 0, "proowner": "10", "proconfig": null, "proretset": true, "prosecdef": false, "prorettype": "2249", "prosqlbody": null, "prosupport": "-", "proargmodes": ["t", "t"], "proargnames": ["schema_name", "bank_id"], "proargtypes": [], "proisstrict": false, "proparallel": "u", "protrftypes": null, "provariadic": "0", "provolatile": "s", "proleakproof": false, "pronamespace": "2200", "proallargtypes": ["25", "25"], "proargdefaults": null, "pronargdefaults": 0}

{"oid": "17541", "proacl": null, "probin": null, "prosrc": "
        DECLARE
            sch text;
        BEGIN
            FOR sch IN
                SELECT n.nspname
                FROM pg_class c
                JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
                WHERE c.relname = 'mental_models' AND c.relkind = 'r'
            LOOP
                BEGIN
                    RETURN QUERY EXECUTE format($q$
                        SELECT %1$L::text, mm.bank_id::text, mm.id::text,
                               mm.trigger->>'refresh_cron', mm.last_refreshed_at
                        FROM %1$I.mental_models mm
                        WHERE COALESCE(mm.trigger->>'refresh_cron', '') <> ''
                          AND NOT EXISTS (
                              SELECT 1 FROM %1$I.async_operations o
                              WHERE o.bank_id = mm.bank_id
                                AND o.operation_type = 'refresh_mental_model'
                                AND o.status IN ('pending', 'processing')
                                AND o.task_payload->>'mental_model_id' = mm.id::text
                          )
                    $q$, sch);
                EXCEPTION
                    -- Schema or its tables vanished between the pg_class
                    -- snapshot and this query (tenant dropped or migrating).
                    WHEN undefined_table OR invalid_schema_name OR undefined_column THEN
                        CONTINUE;
                END;
            END LOOP;
        END;

{"oid": "18033", "proacl": null, "probin": null, "prosrc": "
        BEGIN
            IF NEW.status IN ('pending','processing') AND (
                TG_OP='INSERT' OR OLD.status NOT IN ('pending','processing')

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_transition_association_write()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
        DECLARE target_bank TEXT; items JSONB[];
        BEGIN
            IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN items:=ARRAY[to_jsonb(NEW)];
            ELSIF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN items:=ARRAY[to_jsonb(OLD)];
            ELSE items:=ARRAY[to_jsonb(OLD),to_jsonb(NEW)]; END IF;
            -- Both row ownership and every endpoint join the same sorted set
            -- across OLD/NEW. A mislabeled link cannot escape the Bank whose
            -- paired snapshot actually retains it, even during cascades.
            FOR target_bank IN
                SELECT DISTINCT bank_id FROM unnest(items) AS row_data(item)
                    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                        SELECT item->>'bank_id' AS bank_id
                        UNION
                        SELECT bank_id FROM "public".memory_units WHERE id::text IN
                            (item->>'unit_id',item->>'from_unit_id',item->>'to_unit_id')
                        UNION SELECT bank_id FROM "public".invalidated_memory_units WHERE id::text IN
                            (item->>'unit_id',item->>'from_unit_id',item->>'to_unit_id')
                        UNION SELECT bank_id FROM "public".entities WHERE id::text IN
                            (item->>'entity_id',item->>'entity_id_1',item->>'entity_id_2')
                    ) owned WHERE bank_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY bank_id
            LOOP PERFORM "public".check_transition_publication(target_bank); END LOOP;
            IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;
            RETURN NEW;
        END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.banks_needing_consolidation()
 RETURNS TABLE(schema_name text, bank_id text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
        DECLARE
            sch text;
        BEGIN
            FOR sch IN
                SELECT n.nspname
                FROM pg_class c
                JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
                WHERE c.relname = 'memory_units' AND c.relkind = 'r'
            LOOP
                BEGIN
                    RETURN QUERY EXECUTE format($q$
                        SELECT %1$L::text, m.bank_id
                        FROM %1$I.memory_units m
                        JOIN %1$I.banks b ON b.bank_id = m.bank_id
                        WHERE m.consolidated_at IS NULL
                          AND m.consolidation_failed_at IS NULL
                          AND m.fact_type IN ('experience', 'world')
                          AND COALESCE(b.config -> 'enable_auto_consolidation', 'true'::jsonb) <> 'false'::jsonb
                          AND NOT EXISTS (
                              SELECT 1 FROM %1$I.async_operations o
                              WHERE o.bank_id = m.bank_id
                                AND o.operation_type = 'consolidation'
                                AND o.status IN ('pending', 'processing')
                          )
                        GROUP BY m.bank_id
                    $q$, sch);
                EXCEPTION
                    -- Schema or its tables vanished between the pg_class
                    -- snapshot and this query (tenant dropped or migrating).
                    WHEN undefined_table OR invalid_schema_name OR undefined_column THEN
                        CONTINUE;
                END;
            END LOOP;
        END;
        $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.schemas_with_expired_operations(p_days integer)
 RETURNS SETOF text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
        DECLARE
            sch text;
            has_expired boolean;
        BEGIN
            -- Zero (or negative) retention means "keep forever": report nothing
            -- so the caller skips the sweep entirely.
            IF p_days IS NULL OR p_days <= 0 THEN
                RETURN;
            END IF;
            FOR sch IN
                SELECT n.nspname
                FROM pg_class c
                JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
                WHERE c.relname = 'async_operations' AND c.relkind = 'r'
            LOOP
                BEGIN
                    -- Matches the worker's prune predicate: only terminal rows
                    -- are eligible, so a schema holding nothing but pending or
                    -- processing work is correctly reported as having nothing
                    -- to prune. Uses idx_async_operations_terminal_cleanup.
                    EXECUTE format(
                        'SELECT EXISTS ('
                        '  SELECT 1 FROM %I.async_operations'
                        '  WHERE status IN (''completed'', ''failed'', ''cancelled'')'
                        '    AND updated_at < NOW() - make_interval(days => $1)'
                        ')',
                        sch
                    ) INTO has_expired USING p_days;
                EXCEPTION
                    -- Schema or its table vanished between the pg_class
                    -- snapshot and this probe (tenant dropped or migrating).
                    WHEN undefined_table OR invalid_schema_name OR undefined_column THEN
                        CONTINUE;
                END;
                IF has_expired THEN
                    RETURN NEXT sch;
                END IF;
            END LOOP;
        END;
        $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.signal_bank_maintenance_admission()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
        BEGIN
            IF NEW.status IN ('pending','processing') AND (
                TG_OP='INSERT' OR OLD.status NOT IN ('pending','processing')
                OR NEW.bank_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.bank_id
            ) THEN
                -- Lock-only admission was invisible to an older RR snapshot.
                -- Touch the owner tuple's MVCC version without changing its
                -- token, expiry, timestamps, or the Bank's logical journal.
                -- Do not request the cursor here: completion/webhook and raw
                -- queue writers can already own an async-operation row.
                UPDATE "public".memory_bank_maintenance SET updated_at=updated_at
                WHERE bank_id=NEW.bank_id;
            END IF;
            RETURN NEW;
        END
        $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.transition_initialization_import(target_bank text, permit jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
            SELECT i.import_id FROM "public".memory_transition_initializations i
            JOIN "public".memory_transition_bank_origins o ON o.bank_id=i.bank_id AND o.creation_id=i.creation_id
            JOIN "public".memory_transition_writers w ON w.bank_id=i.bank_id AND w.writer_id::text=permit->>'writer_id'
            JOIN "public".memory_transition_fences f ON f.bank_id=i.bank_id AND f.generation=w.generation
            WHERE i.bank_id=target_bank AND i.kind='import' AND NOT o.ever_used AND NOT o.deleted
                AND i.import_id::text=permit->>'initialization_import_id'
                AND permit->>'bank_id'=target_bank
                AND to_regclass(permit->>'schema_table')=to_regclass('"public".memory_transition_fences')
                AND w.state='running' AND w.lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp()
        $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.transition_initialization_operation(target_bank text, permit jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
            SELECT i.operation_id FROM "public".memory_transition_initializations i
            JOIN "public".memory_transition_bank_origins o ON o.bank_id=i.bank_id AND o.creation_id=i.creation_id
            JOIN "public".memory_transition_writers w ON w.bank_id=i.bank_id AND w.writer_id::text=permit->>'writer_id'
            JOIN "public".memory_transition_fences f ON f.bank_id=i.bank_id AND f.generation=w.generation
            JOIN "public".async_operations a ON a.bank_id=i.bank_id AND a.operation_id=i.operation_id
            WHERE i.bank_id=target_bank AND i.kind='admission' AND NOT o.ever_used AND NOT o.deleted
                AND i.operation_id::text=permit->>'operation_id'
                AND permit->>'bank_id'=target_bank
                AND to_regclass(permit->>'schema_table')=to_regclass('"public".memory_transition_fences')
                AND a.operation_type='refresh_mental_model' AND a.task_payload=i.evidence->'task'
                AND a.status IN ('pending','processing')
                AND w.state='running' AND w.lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp()
                AND (w.operation_id=i.operation_id OR
